The [[Zaishen Combat]] [[signpost]] is an [[NPC]] that offers a different daily [[Zaishen Challenge Quest]] for gold, faction, experience, and [[Copper Zaishen Coin]]s. You can get the quest rewards from [[Zehnchu]] at the [[Great Temple of Balthazar]].

Unlike the other Zaishen Challenge Quests, Zaishen Combat quests can be [[Quest#Traits|repeated]] on the same day.

==Locations==
*[[The Battle Isles]]
**{{NPC location|Great Temple of Balthazar}}

==Quests==
* The current available quest, as of {{#time: H:i, j F Y }} (UTC), is [[ {{Cycle|ZCombat|+1}} (Zaishen quest)]].

The available quest changes daily, based on a recurring cycle. For a quick overview of which quests will be available in the next days, see [[Zaishen Challenge Quest]]s. For all available quests, see the [[:Category:Zaishen Combat quests|category listing]] and for information about the current or previous cycles, see the [[Zaishen Combat/cycles|cycles subpage]].

==Dialogue==
:"''This is the signpost where Zaishen Combat quests are posted.''"

Alternative with no quests available:
:"''There are no more quests available here today, but other signs may have more postings from the Zaishen.''"

Alternative when you already have the maximum number of quests:
:"''Zaishen battle assignments are limited to 3 at one time.''"

When asked about a quest:
:"''More competitors needed to prove their mettle in combat. Travel to the battlegrounds if you have what it takes to triumph.''"

==Trivia==
* These quests were originally added in the [[Game updates/20090423|23rd April 2009]] update. They became [[Quest#Traits|repeatable]] after the [[Game_updates/20090507|7th May 2009]] update.
